caps.inherited: No cap/schema change. Body/total physical source budgets65536, sourcecount+Q_RECORDS<=16, record objects96, Claim16, Reading32, RunEvidence32, Provenance32, Challenge32, Withdrawal32, UTF8/text/JSON depth12/token/work/native process bounds unchanged.
caps.loops: All closure scans fixed shape maxima; duplicate groups at most32x32, perClaim at most16x32 reading scans, withdrawal predecessor traversal32 rounds of32 records, no recursion/unbounded pending work. Sort uses C(value)=complete canonical UTF8 JSON bytes, cached key total<=Body65536 for one bounded input subtree at a time; output bounded separately. Before publication enforce full canonical output+LF32768, no prefix/trimming.

composition: One coherent public informational component, two internal phases: complete typed closure/withdrawal DAG before any aggregation. Requires retaining the original already computed claim_result through private detailed impact/context bundle, with existing public outputs/private compatibility wrappers preserved. No new parsing of source or deriving qualification from caller data. Public chaining order is component-local only: later fullReplay must separately enforce frozen PREPARSE/BOUNDS/ADMISSION/IDENTITY/REFERENCES/GRAPHS/RECOMPUTATION/IMPORT/OUTPUT order; component successes do not establish that order or fullReplay admission.
entrypoint: check_reading_aggregation(body_raw:object,originals:object,held_update_pins:object,held_withdrawal_pins:object)->owned bounded dict. Complete frozen context/impact/claim/source/input gates including every inherited public output cap/refusal first. Private owned bundle only, no caller dict/bool/schema bypass, no reread/reparse/fetch/model/IO beyond existing pinned loader.
held_withdrawal_pins: Mandatory independently supplied exact builtin tuple of <=32 exact builtin tuples(event_id:str,sha256:str,byte_length:int). Outer count before items; strings exact builtin, eventID existing ASCII Id<=32/pattern-search including admitted finalLF, SHA exact64 lowerhex, integer exact builtin neverbool0..65536. No iterable/custom object, no candidate-derived missing trusted replacement. Scalars immutable; snapshot prior comparison. Match every complete canonical ReadingWithdrawal including predecessorID/reason/provenance/evidence; matching proves integrity under hash assumptions only, independent_custody UNKNOWN and authority NONE.
owner_all_supplied_profile: Explicit owner-adopted restrictive V1 engineering profile: every external Provenance requires a nonnull valid RunEvidence even unused, and every supplied RunEvidence requires registered external Seat and exact Manifest/prompt/settings inputs even unused. Original prose expressly required them in external Reading context; generic schema and that wording alone do not imply this all-orphan strengthening. Validate every supplied record to prevent latent dangling references in successful component outputs. No new authority/authentication/eligibility or cap change.
owner_design_choices: Run raw_run_evidence kind PROVENANCE_EVIDENCE is explicit V1 closure choice resolving absent original kind. Run model/family/provider are preserved claims without invented static Seat equality/validation. Challenge Seat without Reading may be any registered Seat; with Reading matches its actual Seat/Claim. Manual author text equality is only illustrative count rule.
pin_resolution: For named generic Pin fields use global context index: ID exists then exact record_type then exact full canonical record Pin then Blob.kind where applicable. Codes are specified fieldprefix_MISSING / _TYPE / _PIN / _KIND, checked in that exact order. Complete ClaimKey uses actual exact supplied Claim id/revision+sha/bytes; source keys use actual verified originals. All supplied records, including unused ones, are checked. References never fetch or infer missing records.

Calls private impact_details once; runs every unchanged context gate and its output bound. Existing public check_context_bindings extracts same context_result.

All existing impact gates/output bounds run first.

stage_order.rule: Entire frozen context-equivalent inherited gate and all earlier output bounds first, exact inherited errors unchanged. Expose only owned Body/sources/index/ClaimKeys/original claim_result/context result/schema in private bundle.

Wrong outer exact tuple -> READING_PIN_TYPE; len>32 -> READING_PIN_COUNT before item inspection. Wrong item tuple/length3/scalar builtin type (including bool length)->READING_PIN_TYPE; valid-type bounded ASCII/Id/hash/range failure -> READING_PIN_SHAPE. All pin argument validation before set/hash checks.

Body withdrawal IDs globally unique already via context. Held IDs duplicate -> READING_PIN_DUPLICATE; exact supplied withdrawal-ID set mismatch -> READING_PIN_SET; every canonical complete Withdrawal hash/length in C(id) order -> READING_WITHDRAWAL_PIN. All events including unreachable predecessors must match; no inferred held pin.

Every Provenance C(id): manual origin requires MANUALLY_AUTHORED_ILLUSTRATION and run_evidence_id=null; external origin requires RECORDED_UNVERIFIED_EXTERNAL_RUN and nonnull run_evidence_id, else READING_PROVENANCE_ORIGIN. External run symbolic ID exists as RunEvidence, else READING_PROVENANCE_RUN_MISSING / _TYPE. Then optional evidence uses Pin resolver prefix READING_PROVENANCE_EVIDENCE, required Blob kind PROVENANCE_EVIDENCE. Original author/limitations remain immutable declared text; author equality never authenticates.

Every RunEvidence C(id): seat_id actual Seat else READING_RUN_SEAT_MISSING / _TYPE, origin external else READING_RUN_SEAT_ORIGIN. InputManifest Pin resolve prefix READING_RUN_MANIFEST; run prompt/settings exact equal selected Manifest prompt/settings in that order else READING_RUN_CONTEXT. Manifest already binds Task/Claim/source/static context. response Pin resolver prefix READING_RUN_RESPONSE, Blob kind RAW_RESPONSE. Optional raw_run_evidence prefix READING_RUN_RAW_EVIDENCE, Blob kind PROVENANCE_EVIDENCE (explicit owner V1 kind choice, formerly unspecified). Optional externally_pinned_eligibility_policy exact SourceKey among verified originals else READING_RUN_POLICY_SOURCE. Provider/model/family/run/time remain declared unverified claims, no invented model/family equality or attestation. Even a supplied policy never makes an external run eligible.

Every Reading C(id): seat_id actual Seat else READING_SEAT_MISSING / _TYPE; ClaimKey exact supplied key else READING_CLAIM; input_manifest Pin resolve prefix READING_MANIFEST; then task_view_id sole Task.id and Claim/task/source_versions/prompt/settings exactly selected Manifest inputs else READING_INPUT_CONTEXT. source_versions compare full unique keys, already canonical ordered by context. response Pin resolver prefix READING_RESPONSE kind RAW_RESPONSE; provenance Pin resolver prefix READING_PROVENANCE kind Provenance. Reading.origin_kind equals both Seat and selected Provenance origin else READING_ORIGIN. Manual provenance coherence already checked. External Reading selected Provenance.run_evidence_id resolves actual alreadychecked RunEvidence; its seat_id/input_manifest/prompt/settings/response must exactly equal Reading tuple else READING_RUN_CONTEXT. Actual first-output provenance is declared, not independently attested; response record/payload integrity is checked, no response parser or stance inference.

Every Challenge C(id): exact ClaimKey else READING_CHALLENGE_CLAIM; optional reading_id actual Reading else READING_CHALLENGE_READING_MISSING / _TYPE; optional seat_id actual Seat else READING_CHALLENGE_SEAT_MISSING / _TYPE. If reading nonnull, its exact Claim matches and any nonnull Seat equals that Reading Seat, else READING_CHALLENGE_CONTEXT. Seat without reading may be any registered Seat, no expected-roster restriction. Provenance Pin resolver prefix READING_CHALLENGE_PROVENANCE; optional evidence prefix READING_CHALLENGE_EVIDENCE kind CHALLENGE_EVIDENCE. Challenge remains UNRESOLVED_INFORMATIONAL. Then all Readings C(id), each challenge_ids C(string): resolve actual Challenge else READING_CHALLENGE_REFERENCE_MISSING / _TYPE; exact same Claim and challenge.reading_id null or this Reading.id else READING_CHALLENGE_REFERENCE_CONTEXT. An unattached Claim challenge with reading_id=null need not match listing Reading Seat; no invented additional owner condition. Every Claim challenge appears in aggregation even unlisted by any Reading.

Every Withdrawal C(id): reading_id actual Reading else READING_WITHDRAWAL_READING_MISSING / _TYPE; provenance Pin resolver prefix READING_WITHDRAWAL_PROVENANCE; optional evidence prefix READING_WITHDRAWAL_EVIDENCE kind WITHDRAWAL_EVIDENCE. Compute manual_count_effect=EXCLUDES_MANUAL_FIXTURE iff target Reading and both target/withdrawal Provenance have manual origin/coherent manual method and author_claim strings exactly equal; otherwise NO_COUNT_EFFECT, never authority, erasure or malformed-data tolerance. Different author/manual-vs-external coherent requests remain visible and ineffective; malformed/missing declared records refuse earlier. Every withdrawal is retained.

Each nonnull predecessor_withdrawal_id in C(eventID) order resolves actual supplied Withdrawal (and already held matched pin), else READING_WITHDRAWAL_PREDECESSOR_MISSING; same target reading_id else READING_WITHDRAWAL_PREDECESSOR_CONTEXT. No missing-to-root coercion. Check all events for self/multi-cycle by separate bounded iterative32-round DAG, else READING_WITHDRAWAL_PREDECESSOR_CYCLE. Existing max8 Update helper is not silently raised/reused; this is separate schema32 Withdrawal DAG. Predecessor means informational request precedence, not authorization or effective revocation.

Only after every closure/DAG gate succeeds, compute each exact ClaimKey in tuple(C(id),C(revision)) order. Raw counts include every Reading exactly once. Duplicate group=(exact ClaimKey,SeatID) of size>1; all members duplicate, never dedup. Eligibility priority duplicate -> unexpected expected-roster Seat -> coherent manual withdrawal -> external/unverified -> eligible manual illustration. Retain all applicable ineligibility condition names as sorted reason_codes; if none, sole ELIGIBLE_MANUAL_FIXTURE_ONLY code. Unexpected means registered but absent expected roster; missing Seat refused earlier. Withdrawn condition iff >=1 target withdrawal with EXCLUDES_MANUAL_FIXTURE; include ALL target withdrawal IDs regardless effect. External always INELIGIBLE_UNVERIFIED even policy source supplied. Structural qualification is independent exact mapping of retained original claim_result: MATCHED_DECLARATION_STRUCTURE_ONLY=>QUALIFIED_STRUCTURE_ONLY; DIFFERS_DECLARATION_STRUCTURE_ONLY=>UNQUALIFIED_MISMATCH; UNRESOLVED_UNSUPPORTED_PROFILE=>UNQUALIFIED_UNSUPPORTED; UNRESOLVED_INSUFFICIENT_SCOPE=>UNQUALIFIED_INSUFFICIENT_SCOPE; NOT_CHECKED_MISSING_EVIDENCE=>NOT_EVALUATED. No inventing a qualified result from agreement.

Reuse exact frozen Aggregation and ReadingDisposition closed shapes. Raw stance counts all; eligible_counts only eligible manual observations; structurally_qualified_counts eligible plus QUALIFIED_STRUCTURE_ONLY. present expected Seats with >=1 Reading regardless eligibility/abstain/withdrawal; missing expected minus present. raw_dissent all OPPOSE/DISPUTE; ineligible subset; qualified_dissent eligible+qualified dissent. abstaining all ABSTAIN. duplicate IDs every member of duplicate group, no suppression. challenge_ids every exact Claim Challenge; withdrawal_ids every withdrawal targeting Claim Reading. For eligible and qualified decisive stance sets independently, exclude ABSTAIN: zero=>NO_DECISIVE_READINGS, one=>SINGLE_DECISIVE_READING, >=2 all identical stance=>RECORDED_AGREEMENT else RECORDED_DISAGREEMENT. DISPUTE/OPPOSE agreement remains dissent, no threshold/majority/truth. observation_class by raw origins: none NO_RECORDED_READINGS; manual only MANUAL_FIXTURES_ONLY; external only UNVERIFIED_EXTERNAL_RECORDS_ONLY; both MIXED_MANUAL_AND_UNVERIFIED. All set-valued arrays sorted C; ReadingDisposition rows C(readingID); threshold_verdict NOT_DEFINED.

Materialize complete closed result only after all checks; canonical output including reserved single LF<=32768 and depth12, else READING_OUTPUT_BYTE_BOUND. No partial result, trimming, nested accepted ReplayResult, state mutation or evidence deletion. All inputs remain exact immutable artifacts.

success_shape.withdrawals: C(id) sorted closed {pin:complete Withdrawal Pin,reading_id,manual_count_effect:EXCLUDES_MANUAL_FIXTURE|NO_COUNT_EFFECT}; every event once, no omitted ineffective request.
